difficulty_reason: Given two schemes locally of finite type over a locally Noetherian base at points over a common point with G-ring local ring, an isomorphism between the complete local rings is realised, modulo the N-th power of the maximal ideal, by a span of two elementary etale neighbourhoods. The proof reduces to the algebra statement about the two completions, builds a common etale neighbourhood through which both maps factor, and then verifies the commutativity modulo the power of the maximal ideal by comparing the induced maps on the completions. Constructing the common neighbourhood and controlling the comparison modulo the power is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 11097-11141.
